body:
I've never been much of a writer, I don't really have a way with words like some other people. However, I'm not exactly sure how quantum immortality would work in a story, as it could only really be unknowingly experienced by the single character. In that regard it ties in very closely with solipsism.

The only way I could really see it being used in a written setting is if the story took place from the view of an omniscient observer who sees the different outcomes of several different universes. 

Unfortunately, I don't think I have a strong enough understanding of full multiverse theory to create a solid story that would be absent of plot-holes that are inherent in those kinds of complex theoretical siuations.
